title: Johnson Controls energy savings contract Phase 3
summary: The administration said Phase 1 cost about $25 million with net savings of $11.9 million, and Phase 3 would cost $9,021,259 plus about 4.49 percent interest through a lease purchase. After a deferral and committee approval, the council voted 9–0 in July to finance Phase 3.

timeline.text: Members voted 9–0 to finance Phase 3 of an energy savings contract, up to $9,021,259 plus interest.
The committee voted to recommend passage of the resolution as amended.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: The committee approved an amendment letting the final financed amount come in lower than the amount stated.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: During testimony, a speaker said they do not consent to the energy contract.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: The proposed cost for Phase 3 is $9,021,259 plus 4.49 percent interest.

timeline.text: The first item was a resolution to finance a Johnson Controls Inc. energy contract through a tax-exempt lease purchase with TD Equipment Finance Inc.
